build.buildCommand: pip install -r requirements.txt && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput

deploy.startCommand: python manage.py migrate --noinput && python manage.py ensure_superuser && python manage.py seed_demo --if-requested && gunicorn config.wsgi:application --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT --workers ${WEB_CONCURRENCY:-3} --timeout 60 --access-logfile -
